scopeBinding: Source case-specific requirements and applicable recipes govern variants, not every broad suite fault list for every file reject. Missing/unknown/container variants cover root/snapshot metadata/overview/all12 categories/all service/answers/pending/operation/context/checksum; file has no separate meta object. SHA recreated versus retained separately. Browser/physical durability/real quota are not claimed by fake IDB.
faultBinding: Only harness wraps native fake-IDB transaction/store/request methods. Sync listener aborts after every request point or throws during mutation dispatch; readonly results altered only for specified readback fault. Native product handlers untouched; no async gap inserted into them. Input/trace/state evidence retained.
verdictRule: PASS only if all vectors and required evidence match; mismatch FAIL; harness/fixture/observation gaps NOT VERIFIABLE; unexecuted NOT RUN. Stop if old-state protection unexpectedly fails, external transport/logging, or fixed-target mutation detected. No product fixes.
